description: Thursday 12:30: Jacqueline Mitchell emails Ryan, in a new thread, a photo of the back of Pop's roast card, his own later note: turn it down to 300, not 325; 1 1/2 cups stock is plenty. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Thursday 12:00: His mother asks whether Andrew is still singing a solo on the 18th, at the winter program, where she wants a seat up front in a WhatsApp message to Ryan (unannounced). Thursday 12:25: Tami asks whether he is bringing the wine or the dip on Saturday, to the book club gathering in a WhatsApp message to Ryan (unannounced). Thursday 12:28: Oscar asks Ryan on WhatsApp what oven temperature and how much stock Pop used (the request that follows names it).

filesystem.description: The attachment of Jacqueline Mitchell (his mother, who keeps Pop's recipe box)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. The back of Pop's card: 300°, not 325, and 1½ cups of stock.

loud.description: Oscar asks Ryan on WhatsApp for Pop's oven temperature and stock.

row.text: Doing a second roast Christmas Day like your father's. What oven temp and how much stock did he use?

silent.description: Jacqueline Mitchell (his mother, who keeps Pop's recipe box) emails Ryan a photo. The back of Pop's card: 300°, not 325, and 1½ cups of stock.
A WhatsApp message lands in Ryan's chat with Jacqueline Mitchell.

row.text: Is Andrew still singing a solo on the 18th? I want a seat up front.

silent.description: A WhatsApp message lands in Ryan's chat with Tamara Johnson.

row.text: Saturday: are you bringing the wine or the dip? Need to know by tomorrow!
